message: The other night, we had an unexpected power outage during dinner, and at first, it felt a bit chaotic. But I remembered I had charged my power bank earlier that day, so I pulled it out to keep my phone alive for some light and entertainment. We ended up playing charades by phone light, laughing and reminiscing about old family stories. It turned what could have been a frustrating evening into a cozy memory instead. Have you had a small win during a power outage that turned things around for you?
